Compute the rendered stair profile from a stair geometry

Source: R/scene_plot.R
compute_geom_layout.Rd

Converts a theoretical stair geometry into a rendered profile. The input going values are measured nose-to-nose. Nosing therefore shifts the visible riser position, while tread thickness reduces the visible height of the riser.

Usage

compute_geom_layout(geometry, nosing = 0, tread_thickness = 0)

Arguments

geometry

A stair_geometry object returned by build_geometry().

nosing

Nosing length, in cm. Default is 0.

tread_thickness

Tread thickness, in cm. Default is 0.

Value

A data frame with additional columns: riser_x and riser_top_y.

Details

The original geometry is not modified.
